scope: Only retrain original25473-parameter Query MLP. Same canonical_matched world-model seed0/update1000 frozen for all runs; seeds0/1 below are QUERY initialization and sampler seeds, not two encoders. No dynamics/encoder/planner training, simulation, new evaluation collection, packages or threshold changes.
initialization: Fresh original Query class, torch seed3000+query_seed, identical state within paired arms. No extra capacity.
normalization: Original query_seed0 normalization reused exactly, fitted previously on AB representation states; no recomputation from C/D or added states.
coverage_aux: 4 root-balanced draws each from holding_open, post_place, holding_closed strata.
shared_base: Exactly same20 state IDs per update across arms, from common128 states, root-balanced.
loss: Same original masked average of Holding BCE, In BCE and drawer3-class CE; validity masks preserved. Both arms use same fixed weights computed from original144 labels, not arm-dependent weights.
selection: Minimum C-selection root-macro masked query loss; earlier tie. All1200 updates run. C-validation not loaded for selection.
C_split_rule: Public root-name rule fixed before new training: blue chain, rep0 fixtures in each colour, blue matched root for selection; remaining C roots held out for query validation.
known_history: C was used in earlier representation experiments; current query selection/validation roots are disjoint but this is not a brand-new unseen world-model generalization test. D/D2 have been inspected repeatedly and are diagnostic backtests only.
source_labels: Existing frozen v2.1 labels, no new labels inferred. Extra matched states have6 valid Holding/drawer facts and3 unknown In facts due missing orientations. Unknown never becomesfalse.
partial_coverage_limit: AB held_closed8 states/4roots; C held_closed4 states/2roots, one root2states in selection and one root2states in validation. Cannot establish complete9-fact held_closed readability or robust cross-root generalization from this data.
allowed_training_data: AB true observation encodings only. No predicted-state labels, D, D2, the5 normal diagnostic roots, or recorded test streams in training/selection.
one_shot: One predefined pair of coverage arms x2 seeds, no iterative repairs or validation-driven changes.
